content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Bitcoin payment

Selling digital products such as ebooks, courses, templates, and software can be lucrative, but conventional payment processors often impose steep fees and restrictions. For instance, Gumroad charges 10% on every sale, which can significantly eat into your profits. In contrast, using Bitcoin through NOWPayments only incurs a 0.5% fee, resulting in substantial savings for creators. At 100 sales per month on a $97 product, the fee difference retains $921 for you. This infrastructure shift not only maximizes your earnings but also grants you complete ownership over your sales process.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The backbone of this payment infrastructure consists of various components working in unison. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages hosts your digital store for free, while Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script manages backend logic effortlessly. Order storage is handled through Supabase or Google Sheets, allowing easy access to your sales data. Finally, NOWPayments processes Bitcoin transactions, automatically verifying payments at a minimal fee. This architecture is designed for efficiency and autonomy, ensuring you retain full control over your digital commerce operations.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators across regions where traditional payment options are scarce or non-existent. If you're in Nigeria, Kenya, or Pakistan, for example, you can now bypass the limitations imposed by platforms like PayPal and Stripe. The aim is to empower creators who sell digital products, allowing them to build a profitable business without the burden of excessive fees or platform dependence. This system fosters sovereignty, enabling you to operate your store on your terms.
Retain more of your sales revenue by using Bitcoin payments.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Each component of this digital commerce stack plays a crucial role. GitHub Pages provides a reliable hosting solution, while Cloudflare Workers executes backend tasks seamlessly. Supabase or Google Sheets ensures that order data is easily retrievable, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 facilitates efficient file delivery. NOWPayments handles the crypto payment processing, allowing for real-time transaction verification. Together, these tools create an integrated system that functions without the need for third-party platforms, giving you complete ownership of your business.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started, first select a hosting option—GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages are both excellent choices. Next, set up backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to manage transactions. Choose Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and utilize Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for digital file delivery. Finally, integrate NOWPayments to handle Bitcoin transactions. For those looking for a comprehensive solution, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all necessary blueprints and templates to launch your sovereign digital commerce stack.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Automate your digital product delivery for a seamless customer experience.

Your Deployment Checklist

Select GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting your digital store. Implement backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for transaction management. Set up Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage to keep track of sales data. Utilize Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for efficient file delivery to customers. Finally, integrate NOWPayments to facilitate Bitcoin transactions, ensuring low fees and real-time payment verification.
Frequently Asked Questions
How can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad?

To sell templates and fonts without Gumroad, set up your own digital store using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Use NOWPayments for Bitcoin processing, allowing you to keep more of your earnings without relying on traditional platform fees.
What payment options can I use for digital downloads?

You can use Bitcoin through NOWPayments for processing your digital downloads. This option allows you to bypass conventional payment processors and their high fees, giving you greater control over your sales.
Is it possible to automate the delivery of digital products?

Yes, you can automate the delivery of digital products using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. These tools can handle order processing and file delivery automatically, ensuring a smooth experience for your customers.
What are the advantages of using Bitcoin for payments?

Using Bitcoin for payments reduces transaction fees significantly compared to platforms like Gumroad. With only a 0.5% fee through NOWPayments, you retain more revenue from each sale, allowing for better profit margins.
Can I manage my sales data without a third-party platform?

Absolutely. You can manage your sales data using Supabase or Google Sheets. This approach allows you to maintain full access and control over your order information without relying on third-party services.
